name: Bandit The Rapper
biography: James Portley born on August 20, 1985 better known as Bandit The Rapper hails from the "City of Brotherly Love" Philadelphia, Pa. Charting on both Billboard and iTunes with songs he has written, produced and performed in the Pop, Rap and R&B genre. Bandit has been featured on MTV, BET, and The Latin Grammys.
